Name: Patrick Stewart Professor Xavier (X-Men) Skin for George
Author: chickensoulforthesoup
Description:
Thinking of one of the coolest fictional people to grace a wheelchair, I wanted to glow up George to look like Patrick Stewart as Professor Charles Xavier from X-Men. This mod replaces the sprites and portraits of George for the base game (one main version and one winter version). 

We love you, Patrick Stewart.

You must have SMAPI 4.5.2 and Content Patcher 2.9.1 (or later) to use this mod.
